cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(test-anyof-unsatisfied C)
find_package(NonExistentProviderA)
find_package(NonExistentProviderB)
if(NONEXISTENTPROVIDERA_FOUND)
    set(USE_PROVIDER "ProviderA")
elseif(NONEXISTENTPROVIDERB_FOUND)
    set(USE_PROVIDER "ProviderB")
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No alternative provider found for capability")
endif()
